OwlProgram LibSource files used by Iro-x
=========================================

These files are unmodified copies of files from the LibSource folder of Rebel Technology's OwlProgram
(the program library of the OpenWare platform), which the Befaco Iroi firmware is written against.

Repository : https://github.com/RebelTechnology/OwlProgram
Commit     : 60f44ab5e0396d504c223f96399d940574e2afad
Folder     : LibSource/
Licence    : GNU GPL version 3 (file LICENSE in this folder)

Files copied (names as in the repository):
  FloatArray.h FloatArray.cpp SimpleArray.h ComplexFloatArray.h ComplexFloatArray.cpp AudioBuffer.h
  SignalProcessor.h SignalGenerator.h StateVariableFilter.h BiquadFilter.h DcBlockingFilter.h
  Oscillator.h MorphingOscillator.h NoiseOscillator.h SineOscillator.h RampOscillator.h SquareWaveOscillator.h
  Interpolator.h SmoothValue.h SimpleValue.h SimpleValue.cpp TapTempo.h
  basicmaths.h basicmaths.c fastlog.h fastlog.c fastpow.h fastpow.c FastLogTable.h FastPowTable.h message.h

Nothing in this folder has been edited. What OpenWare provides at run time on the hardware and what a computer
does not have (the Patch class, the heap, message output, the audio buffer object, the random number generator
and the start-up of the lookup tables) is written new in src/engine/shim/. The build compiles basicmaths.c with
its random number function renamed so that each thread can use its own generator (see CMakeLists.txt).
